title: web service gives EOF during sensor warm-up
symptom: During sensor warm-up, the local web service produces an incorrect error response. Instead of returning a proper HTTP error page, it terminates the connection, causing an unexpected EOF on the client. The client is a Raspberry Pi-based closed loop system that queries the phone every 5 minutes for SGV values.
cause: The thread does not explicitly identify the root cause. It mentions that a pull request (#1800) was created to fix the unexpected EOF bug, but the exact cause is not stated.
fix: The thread indicates that a fix was implemented via pull request #1800, which should fix the unexpected EOF bug. It also suggests trying a newer version of xDrip (at least 2021.05.21) which introduced enhancements to the WebService. The issue is considered fixed as of a later stable release (January 31, 2022).
evidence_quote: @tolot27 created https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/1800 which should fix the unexpected EOF bug.
